Top of the Morning
 

Illustration: Natalie Peeples/Axios
 

We're in the golden age of decacorns.

  • The average time from launch to decacorn has been cut in nearly half, and some decacorns arrive literally overnight.

By the numbers: It took companies globally an average of 5.5 years to hit decacorn status in 2025, data from PitchBook shows.

  • That's down from 9.4 years in 2020, and it's even faster than the 8-year average to hit unicorn status that year.

Zoom(ing): With three months to go, 42 decacorns have been born globally in 2026 — cementing a historic record before expected rounds from companies like 2021-founded Modal's $15 billion valuation.

  • The previous record was 34 in 2021, which surpassed 2020's 14.
  • Seventeen of the 20 fastest decacorns did that in 2025 or 2026. All of which took about three years or fewer to get there.

Case in point: Discovery Loop was reportedly seeking a $10 billion valuation when it was founded in August by former Google chief scientist Jeff Dean, setting it up to become the fastest ever company to hit $10 billion.

  • That target was ramped up to $50 billion last month, per Business Insider.

Reality check: Decacorn status doesn't guarantee long-term success, see proto-decacorn Webvan for proof of same.

Zoom out: The rising tide hasn't excluded companies launched in the pre-AI age.

  • The average age of a new decacorn in 2026 ticked upward to 7.1, thanks to some 16 companies that were born over eight years ago.
  • That includes players like Cerebras (2015), Shield AI (2015), SambaNova (2017), FluidStack (2017), Airwallex (2015), NinjaOne (2013), and Whoop (2012).

Between the lines: The lopsided VC market is a driving force as investors pile into mega-seed deals backing a highly sought-after founder, or later-stage mega-rounds like Anthropic where investors are piling extraordinary amounts of their fund into one bet.

Yes, but: There are cracks in the IPO landscape, with delayed and cancelled offering making November a key month to watch.

  • Weaknesses there could mean a darker ending for this current golden era.

The bottom line: AI is leading to faster-than-ever ramp ups in revenue. It also leading to rapid bid ups in valuation — sometimes without the former.
 
 
The BFD
 

Illustration: Brendan Lynch/Axios
 

SpaceX inked an $8 billion deal to acquire a nationwide low-band spectrum portfolio from Grain Management on Thursday, per the WSJ.

Why it's the BFD: AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile shed some $36 billion in combined market cap on the news.

SpaceX gained 3% — or $67 billion in pre-market trading.

Between the lines: Buying these licenses allows it to reach areas that satellite currently struggles to do, like the inside of buildings.

The bottom line: The spectrum could serve SpaceX's stated ambition of moving its Starlink satellite service beyond broadband into the wireless market to compete with the likes of AT&T and Verizon." — WSJ

Venture Capital Deals
 

🚑 Isomorphic Labs, an Alphabet spinout using AI for drug discovery, is in early talks to raise at a $40b to $50b valuation, per Bloomberg. axios.link/4yz1OUI

• Atomic Machines, an Emeryville, Calif.-based manufacturing system for micro-machines, raised $250m. OneIM, Gigafund, XTX Ventures, KAS Venture Partners, Valor Equity Partners, Tru Arrow Partners, Construct Capital, Sozo Ventures, and the Regents of the University of California invested. axios.link/4dt5wH2

⚡ Voltus, a SF-based flexible energy platform that taps into businesses and homes, raised $225m in Series D funding. Generation Investment Management led the round alongside Activate Capital and Vitol. Broadscale Group, Climate Investment, NGP Energy Capital, Salix Ventures and All Aboard Fund joined. axios.link/4rSzEBw

• Arena Intelligence, an SF-based AI model evaluator, raised $200m at a $3.1b valuation. Lightspeed Venture Partners and Khosla Ventures led, joined by Salesforce Ventures and Dell Technologies Capital. axios.link/4ejXikM

• Hone, a SF-based professional AI agent developer, raised $60m at a $285m valuation, led by Benchmark and co-led by Index Ventures. Elad Gil, Hanabi, Definition, and Diffusion joined. axios.link/4y9NjWu

• Ultra, a Brooklyn-based robots-as-a-service startup, has raised $62m via a $50m Series A led by Framework Ventures with participation from Y Combinator, and an earlier $12m seed round led by Y Combinator and Next View. axios.link/47IoLcd

• Vesta, an SF-based mortgage loan origination system, raised a $30m round. Conversion Capital led, joined by Pennymac, New American Funding, Citi Ventures and Andreessen Horowitz. axios.link/47EwmZo

• Rein Security, an NYC and Tel Aviv-based software developer, raised $25m. Glilot Capital and Sienna Venture Capital led the round and were joined by Corner Ventures, Atlacle, and RNP Capital Advisors. axios.link/4duDomU

🚑 AblePay Health, a Bethlehem, Pa.-based provider of patient engagement platform offering flexible payment options, raised $20m in Series A funding. F-Prime led, joined by A1 Health Ventures and .406 Ventures. axios.link/4yyIo2g

• Sonilo, an SF-based developer of AI tools for video effects, raised $11m. B Capital led the round and was joined by Redpoint. axios.link/47aGf0Q

• Persona, an personal AI agent startup, raised $10m led by Vine Ventures, joined by Z Fellows founder Cory Levy and Collective Global. axios.link/3Ukrp4V

🚑 Vocca, a Paris and NYC-based developer of AI patient communication tools, raised $20m in Series A funding led by Norrsken VC, with participation from Heal Capital, Speedinvest and Firstminute Capital. axios.link/474puEv

• Rebel Audio, a Nashville, Tenn.-based AI podcasting startup, is raising $10m in Series A funding at a $50m valuation. DraftKings co-founder Matt Kalish's Hardscope is leading. axios.link/4hRnV1K

🚑 Outro, a medication tapering support startup, raised $7m in pre-seed and seed funding with participation from Listen Ventures and Cake Ventures. axios.link/4zn8vcy

• Phantom GI, an Israeli developer of a minimally invasive alternative to surgical ostomy, raised a $5m seed led by Pitango Healthcare, with participation from RAD Biomed and RUNI Ventures. axios.link/4dwN2pc

• Peppermint, an SF-based financial operations platform for clinical research teams, raised $4.7m in seed funding. Moxxie led, joined by Homebrew, Better Tomorrow Ventures, Layout Ventures, Digital Health Venture Partners, Night Capital, Benjamin Mann, and Evan Moore. axios.link/4zrUGK5

• Apéro, a Canadian AI-based restaurant reservation platform for Quebec, raised C$5m from Now Book It, a restaurant reservation company within Valsoft. axios.link/4AUlHXV

• Immix, a London-based trading firm for companies to exchange stablecoins between currencies, raised $3.5m in funding. Backers included Crane Venture Partners, BTSE, and Portfolio Ventures. axios.link/4jh7P3P

• Thrixel, a Chicago-based platform for AI agents to assemble and animate in 3D, raised $3m. Investors include Sierra Ventures, MFV Partners, Harper Court Ventures, and Z5 Capital. axios.link/4rQFrHL

Private Equity Deals
 

• AEA Investors and British Columbia Investment Management Corporation acquired Rensa Filtration, a provider of filtration solutions for mission-critical applications, from Audax Private Equity. Audax will retain a minority stake. axios.link/4AWxbdq

• Alliant Insurance Services, backed by Stone Point, acquired Melcher & Prescott, a Laconia, N.H.-based independent insurance agency and brokerage. axios.link/4ze3CCo

• Antenna Research Associates, backed by OceanSound Partners, merged with Empower RF Systems, an Inglewood, Calif.-based manufacturer of high-power solid-state RF and microwave amplifiers. axios.link/4zkgfvP

⚡ Carlyle Group is no longer pursuing an acquisition of most of Russian oil producer Lukoil's international assets after an agreement expired, per Bloomberg. axios.link/4dvDivh

Certerra, backed by OceanSound Partners, acquired Universal Testing & Inspection Services, a materials testing, lab service and analysis for infrastructure projects. axios.link/4s1MQo0

• Duncan Solutions, backed by Gallant Capital Partners, sold Pioneer Credit Recovery, a debt collection service. axios.link/47IloSB

• LongWater Private Equity acquired a majority stake in Blastco, a Channelview, Texas-based provider of surface preparation, industrial coatings and tank rehabilitation services. axios.link/3VEY4T4

• Salt Creek Capital acquired MK Plastics, a Canadian manufacturer of corrosion-resistant industrial and commercial ventilation equipment. saltcreekcap.com

• SRS Acquiom, backed by Lovell Minnick Partners and Carlyle AlpInvest, agreed to acquire Pantarai, a U.K.-based provider of loan closing solutions. axios.link/4hCx6nP

• Verdantas, backed by Sterling Investment Partners, acquired Civilitude Engineers and Planners, and Austin, Texas-based engineering and planning firm. axios.link/4dsaOT8
 
 
Public Offerings
 

• Firmus, an Nvidia-backed Australian data center developer, will postpone its IPO. It was set to raise up to $5.5b. It's now weighing a private round. axios.link/4BbCPZw

• Revolut CEO Nik Storonsky says he's targeting the U.S. for a primary listing of the London-based neobank. axios.link/4AWJq9Y
 
 
Liquidity Events
 

• Harness, an SF-based autonomous software delivery lifecycle platform, acquired select assets of Augment Code, a Palo Alto, Calif.-based coding assistant. Augment Code's backers include Sutter Hill Ventures, SV Angel, Rsquared, Pebblebed, Meritech Capital, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Index Ventures, and Evolution Equity Partners. axios.link/4jLkFY6

• Hexagon AB (STO: HEXA.B) agreed to acquire Rocscience, a Toronto-founded global leader in geotechnical and engineering software, for about $535m. axios.link/4jMum8G
 
 
More M&A
 

• RBC plans to vote against the breakup and sale of H&R Real Estate Investment Trust to investors including Blackstone and GO Residential Real Estate Investment Trust. axios.link/4rQWpWt

• Starbucks (Nasdaq: SBUX) has explored a takeover of Chipotle Mexican Grill (NYSE: CMG), a Newport Beach, Calif.-based QSR with a market cap of about $40b, per the FT. axios.link/4jGcigs

🚑 Viatris (Nasdaq: VTRS), a global drugmaker, announced it will buy Pacira Biosciences (Nasdaq: PCRX) for $1.65b in cash to add two non-opioid pain treatments to its portfolio. axios.link/4hMzGYx
 
 
Fundraising
 

• Balerion Space Ventures, a Dallas-based space, defense, and deep technology investor, raised $200m for its second fund. axios.link/4B1BdS0

• Consonance Capital Partners closed Consonance Private Equity III with $1.4b. axios.link/4hCLDQj

🚑 Stable Asset Management invested $100m in Alchemist Capital, a NYC-based biotech investment firm founded by Andy Tran, previously a principal at Matrix Capital Management. axios.link/3VURvfe

• Taurus Private Markets closed Taurus Private Markets Fund III with over $300m. axios.link/3UdOHcI

• Union Square Ventures raised $900m across a $500m early-stage fund and $500m opportunity fund. axios.link/4hDl8dC
 
 
It's Personnel
 

• Apple plans to name Steve Smith its M&A chief, replacing Adrian Perica, per Bloomberg. axios.link/4dtjZTt
